scenarios.name: Wireless pairing incomplete
scenarios.untested_reason: Titan has no wireless pairing flow (USB-first). Requires feature work before it can be tested.

scenarios.name: Companion app installation fails
scenarios.untested_reason: Not applicable today: Titan installs no on-device app.

scenarios.name: Application launch fails
scenarios.untested_reason: Not applicable today: Titan launches no on-device app.

scenarios.name: Required permission missing
scenarios.untested_reason: No runtime-permission probe exists; collectors run as the adb shell user.

scenarios.name: Device disconnects mid-capture
scenarios.untested_reason: Collector-level behaviour; not a diagnosis scenario.

scenarios.name: Observation request times out
scenarios.untested_reason: Collector-level behaviour; not a diagnosis scenario.

scenarios.name: Setup interrupted and resumed
scenarios.untested_reason: Launcher resume behaviour needs a real-process harness.

scenarios.name: Configuration change invalidates results
scenarios.untested_reason: No result cache keyed by configuration exists yet.

scenarios.name: Windows USB driver absent (device invisible to adb)
scenarios.untested_reason: Indistinguishable from no_device without OS USB enumeration; needs physical-device validation.

scenarios.name: Computer sleep/wake and ADB server restart mid-session
scenarios.untested_reason: Requires a real adb server lifecycle (Layer B).
